newsitem.title: CHINA: China '97 fixed asset investment seen up 18.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: China '97 fixed asset investment seen up 18.5 pct.

text.p: China's investment in fixed assets is forecast to hit 2.8 trillion yuan in 1997, up 18.5 percent from 1996, the official Financial News reported on Thursday.
The newspaper said fixed asset investment would rise by 13.5 percent in real terms for the year.

The year-on-year rise in fixed asset investment in 1997 will be fuelled by steady economic growth and the need for increased investment in a variety of areas, including key state projects, the newspaper said, quoting the State Information Centre.
Investment in real estate in the second half of 1997 will exceed the first half figure, said the centre, which is supervised by the State Economic and Trade Commission.
